summary: Retain the clean hdm copy and remove the duplicate contaminated with hbṭ examples
rationale: Both hdm blocks have identical forms, the destruction sense, and the same three hdm examples (prs 115/6, 96/164, 29/163). The first block additionally repeats the two hbṭ examples verbatim, with hbīṭ/hbiṭono and the same references (prs 223/30 and JL 6.10.18), plus the hbṭ sense as a note. The independent hbṭ entry already retains that material. Keeping the clean hdm.I~2 block and removing hdm.I eliminates the duplicate hdm entry and the misplaced hbṭ material without losing any distinct example.
